milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining birch_log blocks causes them to drop as birch_log items into the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory (confirmed via /clear), so any birch_log presence confirms the task. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted stone_pickaxe ends up in the player's inventory after crafting at the crafting table. The player starts with no stone_pickaxe (empty inventory confirmed). inventory_has is the preferred rule type for craft tasks. The crafting chain requires: birch_log → birch_planks → sticks, then 2 sticks + 3 cobblestone (from chest) → stone_pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because mining andesite blocks with a pickaxe causes them to drop as andesite items into the player's inventory. The player starts with no andesite (empty inventory confirmed). Andesite requires at least a wooden pickaxe to drop as an item — the stone pickaxe from the previous task satisfies this. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
